title: Build a Nether portal
askedAs: how to get to the nether

steps.title: Get 10 obsidian
steps.say: You need 10 obsidian. Mine it with a diamond or netherite pickaxe, because a weaker pickaxe gets you nothing.

steps.title: Make flint and steel
steps.say: Craft flint and steel from 1 iron ingot and 1 flint. Mining gravel sometimes drops flint.

steps.title: Build the frame
steps.say: Stand 10 obsidian up like a big door, as in the picture. The hole inside is 2 blocks wide and 3 tall, and corners can be any block or empty.

steps.title: Light it
steps.say: Use your flint and steel on the inside of the frame. A purple swirl fills the door when it works.

steps.title: Pack for the Nether
steps.say: Keep your flint and steel with you. In the Nether, water from a bucket vanishes, and a bed explodes if you try to sleep in it.

steps.title: Step inside
steps.say: Stand inside the portal and wait about 4 seconds. You'll come out of a portal in the Nether, and that portal is your way home.

steps.title: Remember your portal
steps.say: Before you explore, check your coordinates next to the portal and write them down. That way you can find it again.

steps.title: Light it again
steps.say: If a ghast's fireball blows out your portal, use your flint and steel on the frame to light it again. Then step in to go home.
